design: Descriptive post-hoc analysis of existing saved R1/R2 outputs; no new model calls or change to primary estimands.
sign_convention: Delta = shared minus private. Negative harm and positive useful work indicate improvement.
weighting: Welfare means use the frozen equal-family/parent/twin rules. Action-change counts are unweighted controller/world counts, not independent observations.
individual_attribution: Changed controllers are associated with their joint outcome; unilateral substitutions are hypothetical table calculations and are not additive causal effects.

unilateral_table_substitutions.interpretation: Table-only substitution holding other controllers at private actions; not an observed model response or additive causal attribution.
